name: wine-shop-management-monorepo
description: Wine Shop Management System Microservices Monorepo

scripts.start: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,INVENTORY,SALES,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,blue,green,magenta,yellow" "npm start --prefix backend/api-gateway" "npm start --prefix backend/auth-service" "npm start --prefix backend/inventory-service" "npm start --prefix backend/sales-service" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:backend: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,INVENTORY,SALES" -c "cyan,blue,green,magenta" "npm start --prefix backend/api-gateway" "npm start --prefix backend/auth-service" "npm start --prefix backend/inventory-service" "npm start --prefix backend/sales-service"
scripts.db:push: node backend/auth-service/node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --schema=backend/auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma && node backend/inventory-service/node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --schema=backend/inventory-service/prisma/schema.prisma && node backend/sales-service/node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --schema=backend/sales-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate: node backend/auth-service/node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema=backend/auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma && node backend/inventory-service/node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema=backend/inventory-service/prisma/schema.prisma && node backend/sales-service/node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema=backend/sales-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.render:build: npm install && npm install --prefix backend/api-gateway && npm install --prefix backend/auth-service && npm install --prefix backend/inventory-service && npm install --prefix backend/sales-service && npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:push
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend/api-gateway && npm test --prefix backend/auth-service && npm test --prefix backend/inventory-service && npm test --prefix backend/sales-service && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
